status: CPU and build passed; recipe integration and browser acceptance owned by root

api.prepareUpdate: await layer.prepareUpdate(selection,{hairState}={}) -> prepared update or {applied:false,cancelled:true,reason:cancelled}. Fresh requests increment the actual layer revision and dispose older uncommitted candidates.
api.revision: getState().revision exposes the same revision ticket. status prepared and requested show a staged intent while selection and visible equipment remain unchanged.
api.hairState: Optional structuredClone of a final hair descriptor object. Booleans/functions/skip options reject. Hat prepare and validateCommit use the same exact original assertHatHairSelection with this snapshot. Without it, current getHairState is checked.
api.commit: Synchronous, no network or loader work. Revalidates freshness and actual current getHairState before and after head attachment. Old group is hidden and retained for cleanup. It rejects and releases the new candidate if actual hair/face does not match.
api.dispose: Before commit releases only the new hidden candidate. After commit releases only the previous group. Idempotent and safe after a newer commit or owner disposal. Template source remains the actor-owned bounded cache until layer disposal.
api.setSelection: Retains existing result/error semantics and synchronous none removal/cancellation. Internally uses the same transaction kernel then disposes old resources.
api.ownerDispose: Invalidates revision, disposes pending/committed cleanup records, current group and cached source exactly once.

limits: Lifecycle tests use actual published ear/hat GLTFLoader resources and CPU raw-head fixtures. Final-hair test uses actual original female VRM and actual character appearance loading the exact v2 long-hair resource.
